loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A uses a trimmed mean over a small pool, but its per‑window performance is unstable (large positive error in window 2). Candidate B includes a larger pool, further diluting the strong signal from ONLY_CWT_rf and showing higher variance across windows. Both are less aligned with the series’ trend‑dominated, selective nature compared to the single best model.
